_about: Variant 1. Four schools, one tent each, plus the tentless Strays and the Vigil. Each school has one combat identity resource and one camp bias; the two are the same temperament seen in two places. Numbers are authored, not measured.

combatIdentity.perfectAbsorbExtra: none beyond the shared reward; Fire is paid for staying close and hitting

campBias.arenaLink: start a bout at 30 Heat against a feud target

schools.temperament: patient, intelligent, wins before the fight

campBias.arenaLink: Guile scouting reveals one extra level of the opponent's loadout

schools.temperament: calm, protective, slow to move and hard to move

campBias.arenaLink: an ally with Trust >= 40 watching the Games grants +10 starting HP (the held line)

combatIdentity.perfectAbsorbExtra: deflect: an absorbed projectile of tier <= own unlocked tier is redirected along the aim direction

campBias.arenaLink: Renown from Games won spreads one day faster

nonSchools.name: the Strays
nonSchools.note: No tent, no ration, blamed for every theft. Archetype situation (a).

nonSchools.name: the Vigil
nonSchools.note: Arcane wardens whose salt-wards stop the four elements working inside the camp. They stop violence and punish whoever is caught.

nonSchools.name: the Lanista's household
nonSchools.note: Outside the Door. Speaks through the grille.
